name: Gabe’s Auto Detailing & Ceramic Coating | Tint

reviews.text:
Awesome experience at Gabe’s Detailing! I contacted him via Instagram at 6:50am and not even 20 minutes later I had a reply and an appointment set for 8:50am the same day. Very prompt communication and efficient customer service. He took time out to explain all the tint options to me in full detail. He even helped me make a decision based on my personal preferences. I ultimately decided on carbon ceramic tint, 5% all around and 35% on my windshield for my 2026 Kia Sorento. He and his team immediately got to work on my car. I decided to stay and I’m not even mad about it, they were SO FAST!! And as a woman in a male space, I didn’t feel uncomfortable at all. Kudos to all the men for being respectful!! I really appreciate the level of professionalism I experienced at Gabe’s Detailing. By 9:55am, my car was finished and the end result was beautiful! Very happy with my investment for my brand new baby! 10/10 experience for sure! I would definitely recommend and return for other services!

reviews.author: Shine K

reviews.text: I contacted Gabe's Auto Detailing via Instagram about an issue I had with the tint done by another company. We set up an appointment. When I arrived at Gabe's Auto Detailing, everyone was very professional and treated me like a VIP customer. The customer service is beyond impressive. They answered all my questions, addressed the issue, and got my tint right, removing my old tint and replacing it with ceramic tint. The prices are excellent, especially for their impressive skill level. What stood out to me was the coordination, workmanship, and craftsmanship when they were installing my new tint. They respected my car and left everything clean. I've been to other shops, but this shop is on a different level. The shop is clean, organized, and the outside front of the shop outside is well-maintained. Gabe's Auto Detailing, I appreciate you and cannot thank y'all enough. Please keep up the good work
reviews.author: Theo Williams

reviews.text: These guys are professionals. They know what they’re doing and they work collectively as a finely oiled (in this case tinted) machine. They are skilled craftsmen that get the job done right the first time. Don’t look elsewhere, this is the shop for you. You won’t be disappointed, I’ll be back for sure. Thanks guys, keep up the great work!!
reviews.author: Zack W.

reviews.text:
I just got a new vehicle not too long ago, and have been wanting to get my windows tinted. I live around several tinting businesses however I’m super picky so I found it very difficult to find one I was truly satisfied with. My  man sent me a video of Gabe’s Auto Detailing from instagram and I was immediately sold shortly after I made an appointment to bring my vehicle in. The process was very quick and smooth once I showed up for my appointment they gave me a bunch of information to help me with picking the kind of tints I want, I finally made my mind up and picked out my tints lol and they applied them while I sat and watched Easy peasy just like that. I also added an outside carwash afterwards so my baby can really look good with her new tints.
As for pricing……… Im not going to lie I was extremely apprehensive about the pricing lol but then I immediately checked myself because I wanted quality tints and there’s a price that comes with quality.  I’d say him and his guys are 10/10 their work speaks for itself. Honestly if you’re looking for quality tints I’m telling y'all this is the place to come!
reviews.author: Sanita Jacobs

reviews.text: Gabe Detailing exceeded my expectations! The tint came out flawless — sleek, clean, and exactly as advertised. I’ve gotten so many compliments on the look, and the clarity at night is incredible. Professional, friendly service from start to finish. If you’re even thinking about getting your tint done, don’t hesitate — Gabe is the one to call!
reviews.author: Howard Griffith
